description: This file contains type stubs for various classes and functions related to AOT (Ahead-Of-Time) inference runners and package loaders in PyTorch's C++ extension modules. It provides interface definitions, method signatures, and external references for these components.

classes.name: AOTIModelContainerRunner
classes.description: Protocol defining the interface for model container runners supporting multiple device types.

classes.name: AOTIModelContainerRunnerCpu
classes.description: Implementation of the model runner for CPU backend.

classes.name: AOTIModelContainerRunnerCuda
classes.description: Implementation of the model runner for CUDA backend, supporting multiple overloads for initialization.

classes.name: AOTIModelContainerRunnerXpu
classes.description: Implementation of the model runner for XPU (accelerator) backend with multiple overloads.

classes.name: AOTIModelContainerRunnerMps
classes.description: Implementation of the model runner for MPS (Apple's Metal Performance Shaders) backend.

classes.name: AOTIModelPackageLoader
classes.description: Class responsible for loading model packages, retrieving metadata, and managing constants.

methods.name: unsafe_alloc_void_ptrs_from_tensors
methods.description: Converts a list of tensors to a list of void pointers.

methods.name: unsafe_alloc_void_ptr_from_tensor
methods.description: Converts a tensor to a void pointer.

methods.name: alloc_tensors_by_stealing_from_void_ptrs
methods.description: Creates tensors by stealing from a list of void pointers.

methods.name: alloc_tensor_by_stealing_from_void_ptr
methods.description: Creates a tensor by stealing from a single void pointer.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes inference on a list of input tensors, optionally using a stream handle.

methods.name: get_call_spec
methods.description: Retrieves the call specifications, likely for kernel or invocation details.

methods.name: get_constant_names_to_original_fqns
methods.description: Returns a mapping from constant names to their fully qualified original function names.

methods.name: get_constant_names_to_dtypes
methods.description: Returns a mapping from constant names to their data type identifiers.

methods.name: extract_constants_map
methods.description: Extracts constants into a map from names to tensors, with a flag for inactive constants.

methods.name: update_constant_buffer
methods.description: Updates the buffer of constants with a new map, with flags for usage and validation.

methods.name: swap_constant_buffer
methods.description: Swaps the current constant buffer, likely for double-buffering.

methods.name: free_inactive_constant_buffer
methods.description: Frees resources associated with inactive constants.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Class constructors for different device-specific runner classes with parameter overloads.

methods.name: get_metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata information about the model package.

methods.name: boxed_run
methods.description: Runs inference with inputs, returning a list of tensors, possibly with some boxed context.

methods.name: get_constant_fqns
methods.description: Gets the list of constant fully qualified names in the package.

methods.name: load_constants
methods.description: Loads constants into the package loader with mapping and usage flags.
